query:
SELECT usr.id, usr.shareCode, usr.reportType, usr.createdByUserId, usr.createdByName, usr.address,
  JSON_LENGTH(usr.reportData, '$.comparables') as comp_count,
  JSON_EXTRACT(usr.reportData, '$.historicalData') IS NOT NULL as has_historical,
  JSON_EXTRACT(usr.reportData, '$.marketInsights') IS NOT NULL as has_market_insights,
  JSON_EXTRACT(usr.reportData, '$.revenueScenarios') IS NOT NULL as has_scenarios,
  JSON_EXTRACT(usr.reportData, '$.rawMarketData') IS NOT NULL as has_raw_market
FROM universal_shareable_reports usr
WHERE usr.reportType = 'validator' 
ORDER BY usr.id DESC 
LIMIT 10;
